title: Vibration isolators for cooling towers.
officialText: Where a replacement cooling tower is installed and physical limitations prohibit compliance with the vibration isolator requirements of Section 928.3.7, such isolators may be omitted provided the devices shall comply with the New York City Noise Control Code.
